name: SiteFix – Accessibility Plugin | WCAG & ADA Fixes
author: PluginJoy

sections.description:
SiteFix is the ultimate accessibility plugin that automatically audits and fixes your site to meet WCAG 2.1 AA and ADA compliance standards, supercharging your Lighthouse accessibility scores without hassle. This lightweight, backend-only tool uses server-side patches and smart JavaScript—no bulky widgets or layout shifts.

Why Choose SiteFix for Accessibility?

  • Instant Lighthouse Accessibility Boost: Gain 10-20+ points in audits effortlessly with WCAG-compliant fixes.
  • Universal Compatibility: Works seamlessly with Gutenberg blocks, Elementor widgets, and any theme—handles dynamic content via MutationObserver.
  • Zero Configuration Needed: Enable fixes in the dashboard; they apply site-wide on the fly for instant ADA compliance.

Free Features (4 Core Accessibility Fixes):

  • Automatic Alt Text Injection: Generates descriptive alt attributes from image filenames for screen reader support and WCAG success.
  • Heading Hierarchy Enforcer: Ensures logical H1-H6 structure with regex and JS—no skips for better navigation.
  • Focus & Skip Links Enhancer: Adds visible outlines for keyboard navigation plus hidden skip-to-content links.
  • Link Name & ARIA Fixer: Injects ARIA labels for empty links, ensuring discernible names and full accessibility.

Ideal for SEO—accessible sites rank higher, reduce bounce rates, and improve user trust!

Upgrade to Pro for advanced accessibility tools like contrast boosters, AI-powered alt text, full ARIA roles, unlimited audits, and a printable compliance report: Get SiteFix Pro Now ($39 lifetime).

“SiteFix transformed our site’s accessibility overnight—Lighthouse jumped from 65 to 95 with automatic WCAG fixes!” – Happy User

Ready to achieve WCAG & ADA compliance? Install now and run your free accessibility audit today!
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/sitefix/.
  2. Activate via the Plugins menu.
  3. Head to SiteFix > Dashboard to run your first accessibility audit and enable WCAG fixes.
sections.faq:
How does SiteFix boost my Lighthouse accessibility score?

By automatically applying WCAG 2.1 AA fixes to issues like missing alt text, poor headings, and weak focus indicators. Users report 10-20+ point gains—test with a free audit!

Is SiteFix compatible with Gutenberg and Elementor for accessibility?

Yes! Its universal server-side filters and JS handle static and dynamic content perfectly, ensuring ADA compliance across builders.

What’s the difference between Free and Pro versions of this accessibility plugin?

Free offers 4 core fixes for quick WCAG wins. Pro adds contrast enhancement, AI alt text generation, ARIA landmarks, unlimited audits, and a compliance report. Upgrade here.

Does SiteFix cause layout shifts or slow down my site?

No—its runtime-only patches are bloat-free, optimized for speed, SEO, and zero cumulative layout shift penalties.

How can SiteFix help with ADA compliance and accessibility lawsuits?

It automates key WCAG 2.1 AA fixes to enhance compliance, but consult a professional for full legal advice. SiteFix gets you 80% there instantly.

How does the automatic alt text fixer work in SiteFix?

It scans images on-the-fly, adding descriptive alt attributes based on filenames or context to boost screen reader accessibility and Lighthouse scores.

Can SiteFix improve keyboard navigation and ARIA attributes?

Absolutely—enables visible focus outlines, skip links, and ARIA labels for empty links, making your site more inclusive.

Is SiteFix the best free accessibility plugin for WCAG compliance?

With its zero-config fixes and universal compatibility, it’s a top choice for boosting accessibility without complexity.
